blocks.prompt: 1. Find the equation of the tangent line to the curve \(y = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) + \cos x\) at the point where \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh tangent line ka sawal hai, aur line ke liye humein do hi cheezein chahiye: ek point aur ek slope.
Diya kya hai? Curve \(y = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) + \cos x\) aur \(x_0 = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Us point par tangent ki equation.
Rule kaunsa? Point-slope form \(y - y_0 = m(x - x_0)\), jahan slope \(m\) derivative se aata hai.
Plan: pehle \(y_0\) curve se, phir \(\frac{dy}{dx}\), phir us mein \(x_0\) rakh kar \(m\), aur aakhir mein line.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) + \cos x\) ...(1), aur \(x_0 = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Maloom karna: is point par tangent ki equation.
Tareeqa: point-slope form \(y - y_0 = m(x - x_0)\). \(y_0\) equation (1) se milega aur slope \(m = \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x = \pi/2}\), yani pehle derivative, phir value.

Curve par point
\[y_0 = \sin^{-1}\dfrac{\pi}{4} + \cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\dfrac{\pi}{4} + 0\]
\[\approx 0.9033\]
Kyun: (1) mein \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) rakha. \(\frac{x}{2} = \frac{\pi}{4} \approx 0.7854\) hai jo \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan hai, is liye \(\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{4}\) maujood hai. Calculator ko radian mode mein rakh kar \(\sin^{-1}(0.7854) \approx 0.9033\) aata hai. \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\).
Dhyan dein: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{4}\) ka matlab \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) nahi. Yahan \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ek number (0.7854) hai aur hum woh angle dhoond rahe hain jis ka sine 0.7854 ho.

(1) ko differentiate karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1 - \frac{x^{2}}{4}}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{2} - \sin x\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}} - \sin x\]
Kyun: \(\frac{d}{dx}\sin^{-1}u = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\frac{du}{dx}\) (2.4 ka formula) mein \(u = \frac{x}{2}\), aur \(\frac{du}{dx} = \frac{1}{2}\). Phir \(\sqrt{1 - \frac{x^{2}}{4}} = \frac{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}}{2}\) likha, to upar neeche wale \(\frac{1}{2}\) cancel ho gaye. \(\cos x\) ka derivative \(-\sin x\).
Dhyan dein: chain rule ka \(\frac{1}{2}\) bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

\(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par slope
\[m = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{4 - \frac{\pi^{2}}{4}}} - \sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{16 - \pi^{2}}} - 1\]
\[\approx 0.8078 - 1 = -0.1922\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{4 - \frac{\pi^{2}}{4}} = \sqrt{\frac{16 - \pi^{2}}{4}} = \frac{\sqrt{16 - \pi^{2}}}{2}\), is liye 1 ko is se divide karne par \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{16 - \pi^{2}}}\) aaya. \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\). Decimal mein \(\pi^{2} \approx 9.8696\), to \(\sqrt{6.1304} \approx 2.4760\).

Tangent ki equation
\[y - y_0 = m\left(x - \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\]
\[y - \sin^{-1}\dfrac{\pi}{4} = m\left(x - \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\]
jahan \(m = \frac{2}{\sqrt{16 - \pi^{2}}} - 1\). Decimals mein:
\[y - 0.9033 = -0.1922(x - 1.5708)\]
\[y \approx -0.1922x + 1.2053\]
Kyun: point-slope form mein values rakhin. Exact jawab mein \(\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{4}\) aur \(\pi\) waise hi rehne dein; decimal shakal sirf samajhne ke liye hai: \(0.1922 \times 1.5708 \approx 0.3020\), aur \(0.9033 + 0.3020 = 1.2053\).

Tasdeeq
\(x = 1.5708\) rakhein to line \(-0.3019 + 1.2053 \approx 0.9033 = y_0\) deti hai, yani line point se guzarti hai. Slope chhota aur negative hai: \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) ke qareeb \(-\sin x \approx -1\) thora sa bara hai \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}} \approx 0.81\) se, is liye curve wahan halka sa neeche ja raha hai. Jawab maqool hai.
